name: ascii-morph
title: ASCII Morph
description: A cloud of characters that morphs into a globe, a flower, and an A1 monogram.

useCases: Interactive ASCII illustrations for landing pages, portfolios, and identity studies.
limitations: Three built-in silhouettes only: globe, flower, and A1. Does not convert images or arbitrary text into ASCII.
requirements: React, Tailwind CSS, and Motion. Uses SVG, matchMedia, and IntersectionObserver. Reduced motion cross-fades between shapes in place. No automatic animation or pause control is needed.

docs: Read http://localhost:3000/docs/blocks/ascii-morph.md for usage, required props, and integration instructions.
